faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Family Court Muzaffarnagar Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Consultant post at Family Court Muzaffarnagar is 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates should be a Graduate in Sociology or Psychology. A Master's in Social Work with 2 years of experience in family counseling is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Consultant position?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 35 years and the maximum age limit is 65 years for the Consultant post.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Consultant post in the Family Court Muzaffarnagar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Consultant role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 1000 per working day or Rs. 24000 per month, whichever is less.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Application Screening and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Consultant position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Family Court Muzaffarnagar, and links are provided in the Important Links section.
